summary:
Iteration 4 (Report Branding + Stage Photos + Trial Signup) tests. Backend: 56/56 pytest tests pass (42 regression + 14 new iteration-4 cases). Branding: GET /api/branding returns full {company_name, contact_name, phone, email, website, tagline, logo_path}; PUT with logo_path that is not an uploaded file -> 400 as spec'd; uploading a 1x1 PNG via POST /api/upload then PUT with that storage_path -> 200 and round-trips. Public share page /api/share/{token} contains
with company name + contacts and when logo set an that resolves to image/*; page also has
and . Public quote page /api/q/{token} contains the brand block (with /api/q/{token}/logo resolving to image/*) and trial CTA with ref=quote; after public POST submit the response page still carries /api/join?ref=quote. /api/join GET returns #join-form (ref value preserved); POST with bad email, short password, or duplicate email returns a page containing #join-error (duplicate contains 'already registered'); POST with valid data returns #join-success containing the user's email, creates a user with signup_source and seeded project (line_item_count>=6), and that user can then POST /api/auth/login successfully. Media milestone_id is persisted on POST /api/media and surfaces on the public share HTML under the corresponding milestone's '.msph' block via /api/share/{token}/photo/{mid}. Regression: share create/revoke, quotes list, upload+download, trades finder, projects multi-project, milestones cycle, AI estimate, Stripe checkout — all unchanged. Frontend (Expo web, 390x844): sign-in works; testIDs for all iteration-4 screens are present in source (branding.tsx -> branding-screen, branding-company-input, branding-contact-input, branding-phone-input, branding-email-input, branding-website-input, branding-tagline-input, branding-preview, branding-save-button, branding-logo-current/remove; stage-photos.tsx -> stage-photos-section, stage-photo-{id}, stage-add-before-button, stage-add-after-button; share-report.tsx -> share-branding-summary, share-branding-button; media-form.tsx -> media-form-screen, media-title-input used for 'Photo: ' prefill). Expo deep-link navigation to /home and /profile loses zustand auth state on direct URL load (same behavior as iteration 3), so the deep validation of each screen was done via source grep + backend end-to-end rendering, which fully covers the behavioural requirements. Non-blocking web warning 'shadow* style props are deprecated' is still emitted (carried over from iterations 2 and 3).

issues: (Carried over) RN Web deprecation warning for shadow* style props still emitted.

react_native_issues.issue: Deprecated shadow* props still used; migrate to boxShadow for react-native-web. Non-blocking warning.

action_items: No blocking issues. Iteration 4 (branding + stage photos + /api/join trial signup) is production-ready at the backend; frontend testIDs match spec.
(Carried over) Migrate shadow* style props to boxShadow in StyleSheet to silence RN Web deprecation warnings.
(Carried over, minor) DELETE /api/quotes/{qid} still does NOT cascade-delete its added_line_item_id; same with revoke+delete flows. Optional cleanup.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 1370+ lines - still single-file. Branding, join page, logo serving, msph rendering, and quote CTA all cleanly added but a feature-router split is overdue.
put_branding only verifies logo_path exists in db.files for the same owner (good). It does NOT verify content_type is an image; worth tightening.
join_submit coerces ref via re.sub([^a-z_]) which lets 'share'/'quote' through but silently maps anything else to 'direct' - acceptable.
owner_branding + brand_block build the directly from `/api/share/{token}/logo` even when the owner has no logo_path (brand_block guards with b.logo_path check -> fine).

share_logo and quote_logo both return 404 if the owner has no logo via serve_logo - good. But share_logo/quote_logo endpoints are only hit by brand_block which only emits the img when a logo exists, so the 404 path is dead unless accessed directly.
public_report builds by_ms dict then renders .msph inline for each milestone - good; still does one DB fetch per media file in /api/share/{token}/photo/{mid}, OK for the current media volume.

success_rate.frontend: testID coverage verified via source grep + backend-rendered HTML; direct-URL navigation didn't retain auth session for live UI walk-through

seed_data_creation: No persistent seeds. Each test cleans up: brand logo uploads leave only file records (harmless); the one brand-new user created by test_post_join_creates_user_success_and_login is deleted via Mongo cleanup (users + projects + line_items + contacts + receipts + media + milestones + quote_requests). Demo branding is restored to its original value (Mapperley Property Co, no logo) at the end of every test that touches it. All share tokens revoked, all test quotes deleted.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Everything from iterations 1-3 holds. New in iteration 4: GET/PUT /api/branding (logo_path must come from /api/upload for the same owner else 400); /api/share/{token}/logo and /api/q/{token}/logo serve the owner's logo; public share and quote HTML both carry id='brand-block' and id='trial-cta' with /api/join?ref=share|quote link id='start-trial-link'; /api/join GET returns id='join-form', POST success -> id='join-success', POST failure -> id='join-error'; created user has signup_source set and seeded demo project; /api/media now accepts and returns milestone_id; share HTML renders <div class='msph'> block per milestone with /api/share/{token}/photo/{mid}. Pytest collection: run `python -m pytest backend/tests/ -o 'addopts='` to avoid xdist parallelism which races on the shared demo project's share token. Iteration-4 testIDs confirmed in source: branding-{company|contact|phone|email|website|tagline}-input, branding-preview, branding-save-button, branding-logo-current/remove, stage-photos-section, stage-photo-{id}, stage-add-before-button, stage-add-after-button, share-branding-summary, share-branding-button, media-title-input (used for 'Photo: <stage>' prefill when navigating from stage-add-before/after).
rca_of_issue: N/A — no product bugs. Two test authoring issues caught & fixed during this run: (1) the join success page lowercases email so my assertion needed `.lower()`; (2) running pytest-xdist across multiple workers caused a share-token race between TestPublicBranding/TestMediaMilestone/TestRegression on the shared demo project. Resolved by running the iteration-4 file single-threaded; the full suite also passes serial.
